description:
> Hello! We are Team MARATHA from India. We are building a Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space .

*TITLE:*

> ASTRA-HEALTH - AI Health Monitoring for Astronauts

*SUMMARY:

> In space, there is no doctor. ASTRA-HEALTH monitors Heart Rate, Oxygen, Radiation and Sleep of astronauts in real-time and gives instant AI Doctor advice. It gives Red Alert before health becomes critical, to save lives on Moon and Mars
summary:
ASTRA-HEALTH: Your Doctor in Space

PROBLEM: In deep space there is no hospital, no doctor, and up to 22-min delay to Earth. A small health issue can become life-threatening.

SOLUTION: ASTRA-HEALTH is an AI-powered Self Health Assessment Tool for ISS, Spacecraft, Rover, Moon Base and Mars Base. Any astronaut can check health in 30 seconds, even with gloves, in low light, and without internet.

FEATURES:
1. NASA's 5 Hazards: Radiation, Isolation, Distance, Altered Gravity, Hostile Environment.
2. 6 Vitals: Heart Rate, Blood Oxygen, Radiation Dose, Sleep, Blood Sugar, Stress.
3. Smart Environments: Limits auto-change for ISS, Spacecraft, Rover, Moon and Mars.
4. Live Data: Real-time ISS location every 5 sec + real radiation calculation.
5. AI Doctor 24/7: If vitals turn critical, Red Alert + 3 simple steps + Auto SOS to Mission Control.
6. Smartwatch + Sleep Tracker + Health Points.

IMPACT: Built for Artemis Moon and future Mars Missions to reduce emergencies and save crew lives.

Tech: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, NASA Open Data API.
Live: https://nasal-final2.vercel.app
